# Using the Auto-Generated theme.css

## Overview

The `@ideasui/theme` package now includes an **auto-generated `theme.css`** file that consumers can import for semantic theme-aware styling with Tailwind v4.

## For Consumers

### Installation

```bash
npm install @ideasui/theme
```

### Usage

Import in your app's globals.css:

```css
/* app/globals.css */
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@ideasui/theme/theme.css';

/* Scan your code */
@source './app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}';
```

That's it! You now have access to semantic color utilities.

### Available Utilities

```tsx
// Semantic colors
<button className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">Primary</button>
<button className="bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground">Secondary</button>
<button className="bg-danger text-danger-foreground">Delete</button>

// Automatic dark mode
<div className="bg-background text-foreground">
  Automatically switches between light/dark
</div>

// Borders and rings
<input className="border-border focus:ring-ring" />
```

### Color Variables

| Utility Class     | Light Mode      | Dark Mode               |
| ----------------- | --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `bg-primary`      | `primary-500`   | `primary-400` (lighter) |
| `bg-secondary`    | `secondary-500` | `secondary-400`         |
| `bg-danger`       | `danger-500`    | `danger-400`            |
| `bg-background`   | white           | gray-950                |
| `text-foreground` | gray-900        | gray-50                 |

### Dark Mode Setup

Use the `.dark` class or `data-ideasui-theme="dark"` attribute:

```tsx
// Class-based
<html className="dark">

// Attribute-based
<html data-ideasui-theme="dark">
```

## For Library Maintainers

### How It Works

1. **Build Script**: `scripts/generate-theme-css.mjs`
   - Runs during `pnpm build`
   - Generates semantic theme mappings
   - Outputs to `dist/theme.css`

2. **What Gets Generated**:

   ```css
   @import './index.css'; /* Base CSS variables */

   :root,
   [data-ideasui-theme='light'] {
     --primary: var(--ideasui-primary-500);
     --background: var(--ideasui-white);
     /* ...semantic mappings... */
   }

   .dark,
   [data-ideasui-theme='dark'] {
     --primary: var(--ideasui-primary-400);
     --background: var(--ideasui-gray-950);
     /* ...dark variants... */
   }

   @theme inline {
     --color-primary: var(--primary);
     --color-background: var(--background);
     /* ...Tailwind mappings... */
   }
   ```

3. **Size**: ~3.7KB (unminified)

### Customization

To customize the generated mappings, edit `scripts/generate-theme-css.mjs`:

```javascript
// Change semantic mappings
:root, [data-ideasui-theme="light"] {
  --primary: var(--${PREFIX}-blue-600); // Custom shade
  --custom-brand: var(--${PREFIX}-purple-500); // New semantic color
}
```

### Regenerate

```bash
cd packages/core/theme
pnpm build:theme
```

## Comparison with Other Approaches

| Approach             | Setup               | Bundle Size | Type Safety |
| -------------------- | ------------------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| **theme.css** (This) | 1 import            | 3.7KB       | ❌          |
| **Recipes**          | `@source` directive | <1KB\*      | ✅          |
| **index.css**        | 1 import            | 15KB        | ❌          |

\*JIT compiles only used utilities

## When to Use theme.css

✅ **Use if:**

- You want semantic utility classes (`bg-primary`, `text-foreground`)
- You're not using IdeasUI recipes
- You want automatic light/dark mode
- You prefer CSS over TypeScript

❌ **Don't use if:**

- You're already using recipes (recommended approach)
- You need smallest possible bundle
- You want type-safe variants

## Example Project Setup

```
my-app/
├── app/
│   ├── globals.css
│   │   @import 'tailwindcss';
│   │   @import '@ideasui/theme/theme.css';  ← This file
│   │
│   └── page.tsx
│       <button className="bg-primary">      ← Works!
│
└── package.json
    dependencies:
      @ideasui/theme: ^0.1.0
```

## Troubleshooting

### Colors not working

Make sure you imported `theme.css` **after** `tailwindcss`:

```css
@import 'tailwindcss'; /* ✅ First */
@import '@ideasui/theme/theme.css'; /* ✅ Second */
```

### Dark mode not switching

Ensure you're using `.dark` class or `data-ideasui-theme="dark"`:

```tsx
// ✅ Correct
<html className={isDark ? 'dark' : ''}>

// ❌ Wrong
<html style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }}>
```

### File size concerns

If 3.7KB is too much, use the **recipes approach** instead (see [styling_architecture_decision.md](../styling_architecture_decision.md)).
